target.title: fix(feishu): bound stalled docx image URL reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users rendering or uploading Feishu docx images from remote URLs could have the docx workflow hang when the remote image response body stalled.

## Why This Change Was Made

Docx image URL reads now go through a Feishu-local remote image reader that applies both the request timeout and body idle timeout. The timeout is resolved through the existing Feishu HTTP timeout resolver for the selected account, so direct account settings, environment override, and channel config keep their current precedence. File upload remote reads keep their existing behavior, so this stays scoped to docx image handling.

## User Impact

Feishu docx image processing now degrades through the existing error handling instead of blocking the whole document operation on a stalled remote image body. Account-specific Feishu timeout settings are honored for docx image reads instead of being bypassed by a fixed default.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/feishu/src/docx.test.ts` passed: 20 tests.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/feishu/src/docx.ts extensions/feishu/src/docx.test.ts` passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/feishu/src/docx.ts extensions/feishu/src/docx.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Selected-account timeout proof: `feishu_doc` write with `resolveFeishuToolAccount(...).config.httpTimeoutMs = 1234` now calls `readRemoteMediaBuffer` with `timeoutMs: 1234` and `readIdleTimeoutMs: 1234` for the markdown image URL.

- Controlled `feishu_doc` tool proof with redacted Feishu OAPI calls stubbed and the remote image URL fetched through the real shared media runtime over the public network (`httpTimeoutMs: 750`). This demonstrates the document operation returns through the existing image-degradation path instead of hanging:

```text
$ node --import tsx/esm --input-type=module <<'NODE'
<redacted harness: feishu_doc write + Lark SDK OAPI interceptor + real readRemoteMediaBuffer runtime + https://httpbin.org/drip stalled image URL>
NODE
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 750ms (elapsed 751ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=https://httpbin.org/drip
Failed to process image https://httpbin.org/drip?numbytes=5&duration=5&delay=0&code=200: MediaFetchError: Failed to fetch media from https://httpbin.org/drip?numbytes=5&duration=5&delay=0&code=***: request timed out
feishu_doc write returned in 912ms
result.details={"success":true,"blocks_deleted":0,"blocks_added":1,"images_processed":0}
oapi_requests=["POST https://redacted-feishu-oapi/open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal","GET https://redacted-feishu-oapi/open-apis/docx/v1/documents/doc_1/blocks","POST https://redacted-feishu-oapi/open-apis/docx/v1/documents/blocks/convert","POST https://redacted-feishu-oapi/open-apis/docx/v1/documents/doc_1/blocks/doc_1/descendant"]
```

- Controlled stalled-host proof through the shared media reader used by the Feishu docx path:

```text
$ node_modules/.bin/tsx --eval '<local stalled HTTP image server + readRemoteMediaBuffer({ timeoutMs: 1000, readIdleTimeoutMs: 60 }) harness>'
{
  "url": "http://127.0.0.1:<redacted>/stalled.png",
  "elapsedMs": 283,
  "name": "MediaFetchError",
  "message": "Failed to fetch media from http://127.0.0.1:<redacted>/stalled.png: Media download stalled: no data received for 60ms",
  "code": "fetch_failed"
}
```

- Not run: live Feishu tenant / real Feishu doc upload.

AI-assisted change.
